name: Can I temporarily stop a roof leak myself until professionals arrive?

mainEntity.name: Can I temporarily stop a roof leak myself until professionals arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: While it's always best to have professionals handle roof repairs, you can take temporary measures from *inside* your home to mitigate immediate water intrusion. For instance, you can use a tarp or plastic sheeting secured from the inside to divert water into a bucket, or apply roof patch sealant from the ground on accessible low-slope roofs if safe to do so. However, climbing on a wet roof is extremely dangerous and not recommended. These are temporary fixes only and do not address the root cause, so professional repair is still essential.
acceptedAnswer.description: You can take temporary measures from inside, like diverting water with a tarp. Avoid climbing on a wet roof. These are not permanent solutions; professional repair is crucial.
